title: Pure Alien
summary: Pure Alien and A-Counter Reptile control with generic staples. Aliens spread A-Counters across the opponent's board to weaken opposing monsters in battle, steal or destroy them, and lock their effects under Cosmic Slicer Zer'oll.

summary.title: Starters & Counter Spreaders
points: "A" Cell Recombination Device sends an Alien from the Deck to the GY on either turn to place A-Counters equal to its Level on a face-up monster, then banishes itself from the GY on the next turn to search any Alien monster.
Alien Stealthbuster places 2 A-Counters when sent to the GY (stacking with Recombination Device for 6 total counters) and banishes itself from the GY to destroy any card with an A-Counter.
Alien Ammonite is a Level 1 Tuner that revives a Level 4 or lower Alien from the GY when Normal Summoned, providing immediate Synchro or Link material.
Alien Dog Special Summons itself from the hand whenever you Normal Summon an Alien and places 2 A-Counters on opposing monsters.

summary.title: Opening: Alien Ammonite or Recombination Device
steps: Use "A" Cell Recombination Device to send a Level 4 Alien (such as Alien Stealthbuster) to the GY and spread A-Counters, or discard an Alien with Alien Shocktrooper M-Frame.
Normal Summon Alien Ammonite to revive the Level 4 Alien from the GY, and optionally Special Summon Alien Dog from the hand.

Synchro Summon Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar (Ammonite + a Level 4 Alien) to bounce face-up Spells/Traps and convert them into A-Counters, or Link Summon Alien Shocktrooper M-Frame into Cosmic Slicer Zer'oll.

summary.title: Extra Deck Lock & Payoff
points: Cosmic Slicer Zer'oll (Link-3) searches any card with an A-Counter effect on summon (including Code A Ancient Ruins, Planet Pollutant Virus or Brainwashing Beam), forces opposing monsters with A-Counters into Defense Position, and prevents them from activating their effects.

Alien Shocktrooper M-Frame (Link-2) discards a monster as a Quick Effect to distribute A-Counters equal to its Level, and revives Reptiles from the GY up to the opponent's monsters with A-Counters when destroyed.

Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar (Level 5 Synchro) returns face-up Continuous Spells/Traps like Code A Ancient Ruins to the hand to generate A-Counters, then removes 2 A-Counters to destroy any card on the field.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Code A Ancient Ruins accumulates A-Counters whenever Aliens are destroyed and removes 2 A-Counters from anywhere on the field once per turn to revive an Alien—and because it is a soft once-per-turn, Gol'gar can bounce and replay it.
Planet Pollutant Virus tributes an Alien to destroy all opposing face-up monsters without A-Counters and places an A-Counter on every monster the opponent summons for the next 3 turns.
Mysterious Triangle destroys a monster with an A-Counter to Special Summon a Level 4 Alien from the Deck, and Brainwashing Beam steals an opposing monster with A-Counters.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's combo lines splice in Black Garden and outside Synchro engines; this pure build keeps the focus on Reptiles, Aliens and A-Counter Traps.

main: Alien Stealthbuster
Sent to the GY: places two A-Counters on a monster. From the GY: banishes itself to destroy a card with an A-Counter.
Alien Kid
Places an A-Counter on every monster the opponent Special Summons.
Alien Dog
Special Summons itself from the hand when you Normal Summon an Alien, placing two A-Counters.
Alien Ammonite
Level 1 Tuner: Normal Summoned, revives a Level 4 or lower Alien; the Tuner for Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar.
Alien Overlord
Special Summons itself by removing two A-Counters, then puts a counter on every opposing monster each turn.
Alien Telepath
Removes an A-Counter to destroy a Spell or Trap.
Alien Hypno
Gemini: once summoned again, takes control of a monster with an A-Counter.
Alien Warrior
Destroyed by battle: places two A-Counters on the monster that destroyed it.
Alien Grey
FLIP: places an A-Counter; destroyed by battle after flipping, draws a card.
Alien Hunter
Attacks again after destroying a monster with an A-Counter.
I.A.S. -Invasive Alien Species-
Against a Field Spell, can't be destroyed and destroys a monster for 1000 ATK.
"A" Cell Recombination Device
Sends an Alien from the Deck to the GY to put that many A-Counters on a monster; from the GY, adds an Alien to the hand.
Code A Ancient Ruins
Gains counters as Aliens are destroyed; removes two to revive an Alien.
Mysterious Triangle
Destroys a monster with an A-Counter, then summons a Level 4 Alien from the Deck until the End Phase.
Planet Pollutant Virus
Tributes an Alien to destroy every opposing face-up monster without an A-Counter, and counters their next summons.
Brainwashing Beam
Takes control of an opposing monster with an A-Counter while its counters last.
extra: Link-3 for Reptiles: monsters with A-Counters go to Defense and can't activate effects; searches an A-Counter card.
Link-2 for two Reptiles: discards a monster to spread A-Counters equal to its Level.
Synchro of Alien Ammonite and an Alien: bounces Spells/Traps for counters and removes two to destroy a card.
